trial_join_1.table_title: List all countries with their GDP from the IMF for 2026 and their population from the United Nations in 2023.
trial_join_1.db_analog: SELECT country, gdp, population, region, subregion FROM imf_gdp JOIN un_population JOIN un_regions ON country
trial_join_1.temporal_note: GDP updated annually; population updated per UN estimate cycle

trial_join_2.table_title: List each NOC with its rank and medal counts (gold, silver, bronze, and total) in the Summer Olympics in 2020 and 2024.
trial_join_2.db_analog: SELECT noc, rank, gold, silver, bronze, total FROM olympics_2024 JOIN olympics_2020 ON noc
trial_join_2.temporal_note: Past Olympic Games results are fixed

trial_join_3.table_title: List all U.S. states with their Total Area (sq mi), Census population (2020), and House seats (2020).
trial_join_3.db_analog: SELECT state, area, population, house_seats FROM us_states_area JOIN us_census_2020 JOIN us_apportionment ON state
trial_join_3.temporal_note: 2020 census and apportionment are fixed historical values

trial_join_4.table_title: Return the films that appear in both the all-time top 50 highest-grossing films worldwide and the top 50 most expensive films by production budget, including Film Title, Rank (Highest-Grossing), Worldwide gross (USD), Rank (Most Expensive), and Production Budget (USD millions).
trial_join_4.db_analog: SELECT * FROM top50_grossing INTERSECT SELECT * FROM top50_expensive ON film_title
trial_join_4.temporal_note: All-time rankings shift slowly; rare new entries displace existing ones

trial_join_5.table_title: For all countries, list life expectancy at birth in 2024 (all sexes, male, female) and the 2024 median age, according to the CIA World Factbook.
trial_join_5.db_analog: SELECT country, life_exp_all, life_exp_male, life_exp_female, median_age FROM cia_factbook_2024
trial_join_5.temporal_note: CIA Factbook updated annually; 2024 edition values are fixed as reference

trial_union_1.table_title: List all winners of the Academy Award for Best Actor and Best Actress from the 1st Academy Awards (1927/28) to the 97th Academy Awards (2024).
trial_union_1.db_analog: SELECT edition, 'Best Actor', winner, film FROM aa_best_actor UNION SELECT edition, 'Best Actress', winner, film FROM aa_best_actress
trial_union_1.temporal_note: Historical Academy Award results up to 97th ceremony are fixed

trial_union_2.table_title: List the Billboard Year-End Hot 100 singles in 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025.
trial_union_2.db_analog: SELECT 2022, rank, song, artist FROM billboard_2022 UNION ... UNION SELECT 2025, rank, song, artist FROM billboard_2025
trial_union_2.temporal_note: Year-end charts for completed years are fixed

trial_union_3.table_title: List all Nobel Prize laureates in Physics, Chemistry, and Physiology or Medicine from 1945 through 2025 (inclusive), including their year, prize category, laureate name, and nationality.
trial_union_3.db_analog: SELECT year, 'Physics', laureate, nationality FROM nobel_physics WHERE year BETWEEN 1945 AND 2025 UNION SELECT year, 'Chemistry', ... UNION SELECT year, 'Medicine', ...
trial_union_3.temporal_note: Historical Nobel Prizes are fixed; 2025 laureates are included as of cutoff

trial_union_4.table_title: Show City, Building, Height (ft), Floors, and Year Completed for buildings in New York City, Chicago, and Los Angeles with Height (ft) at least 650 (standard height), sorted by Height (ft) in descending order.
trial_union_4.db_analog: SELECT 'NYC', building, height, floors, year FROM nyc_buildings WHERE height >= 650 UNION SELECT 'Chicago', ... UNION SELECT 'LA', ...
trial_union_4.temporal_note: New skyscrapers are rare; list is mostly stable

trial_union_5.table_title: List all games for the PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch, and Xbox One consoles with Copies sold (million) >= 1.00. If the same game was released on multiple consoles, include a separate row for each console.
trial_union_5.db_analog: SELECT 'PS4', game, copies, date, dev, pub FROM ps4_games WHERE copies >= 1 UNION SELECT 'Switch', ... UNION SELECT 'XboxOne', ...
trial_union_5.temporal_note: Sales figures updated as new data is reported; older titles are mostly stable

us_presidents_count_by_birth_state.table_title: For each U.S. state that has been the birthplace of at least one U.S. president, how many U.S. presidents were born there?
us_presidents_count_by_birth_state.db_analog: SELECT birth_state, COUNT(DISTINCT president) AS presidents_born FROM us_presidents GROUP BY birth_state HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT president) >= 1 ORDER BY birth_state
us_presidents_count_by_birth_state.temporal_note: Snapshot taken 2026-04-27 from Wikipedia 'List of presidents of the United States by home state'. Covers presidencies 1 through 47 (George Washington through Donald Trump's second term, inaugurated January 2025). Cleveland (22 and 24) and Trump (45 and 47) each count as one person, so the table aggregates over 45 distinct individuals. The row set will grow only when a new individual is inaugurated as U.S. president whose birth state is not already represented; existing per-state counts may also increment over time.
